alt: Quarto claro com cama arrumada e um canto de trabalho com mesa e cadeira junto à janela
prompt: Bright, calm apartment bedroom in the morning: a neatly made double bed with white linen, two pillows and a folded sage-green throw, light oak nightstand with a small plant, and next to the window a minimal home-office corner with a simple wooden desk and an ergonomic office chair. Wide shot, eye level, airy and uncluttered.

alt: Corte de um colchão de espuma mostrando camadas de espuma sob a capa
prompt: Close-up cutaway cross-section of a generic all-foam mattress resting on a light wooden platform: a quilted white cover on top, below it a softer light-cream comfort foam layer and a thicker, slightly darker support foam layer with fine open-cell texture. No springs at all. Studio-like product shot in a bedroom setting, shallow depth of field.

alt: Corte de um colchão de molas ensacadas mostrando cada mola envolta em tecido
prompt: Close-up cutaway cross-section of a generic pocket-spring mattress on a light wooden platform: a neat row of individually fabric-wrapped steel coils, each in its own white fabric pocket and independent from its neighbours, a thin comfort foam layer above, quilted white cover. Shallow depth of field.

alt: Corte de um colchão de molas interligadas mostrando molas de aço unidas por arames
prompt: Close-up cutaway cross-section of a generic traditional interconnected-spring (Bonnell) mattress on a light wooden platform: bare hourglass-shaped steel coils, wider at top and bottom and narrow in the middle, all linked to each other by thin spiral wires running along the top and bottom edges, a thin felt and foam layer above, quilted white cover. Shallow depth of field.

alt: Corte de um colchão misto com camadas de espuma sobre uma fileira de molas
prompt: Close-up cutaway cross-section of a generic hybrid mattress on a light wooden platform: two thick foam layers (light cream on top, sage-tinted below) resting on a row of fabric-wrapped pocket springs, quilted white cover. The foam layers are clearly thicker than in a regular spring mattress. Shallow depth of field.

alt: Dois travesseiros brancos lado a lado, um alto e outro baixo, vistos de lado
prompt: Side view at eye level of two plain white pillows lying side by side on a made bed with white linen: the left pillow is noticeably tall and plump, the right pillow is low and flat, so the difference in height is obvious. Clean minimal composition.

alt: Cadeira de escritório ergonômica com encosto de tela em um home office claro
prompt: A generic ergonomic office chair with mesh backrest, adjustable armrests, lumbar curve and five-star base with casters, placed at a simple light oak desk in a bright home office, three-quarter view. Minimal, uncluttered.

alt: Cama arrumada com lençóis brancos e travesseiros em um quarto claro
prompt: Close view of a neatly made bed with crisp white linen, two pillows and a sage-green throw in a calm bedroom with light oak furniture.

alt: Duas amostras de espuma de poliuretano com densidades diferentes lado a lado, mostrando a diferença de compressão e textura.
prompt: Close-up flat lay of two foam density samples on a neutral surface, showing cross-sections with different cell structures and compression levels. Left sample appears denser with smaller, tighter cells; right sample shows larger, more open cell structure. Soft natural light creating subtle shadows to highlight texture differences. Minimalist composition emphasizing material properties and tactile quality.

alt: Comparação visual entre dois tipos de material de colchão: espuma e molas, dispostos lado a lado em superfície neutra
prompt: Close-up flat lay photography showing cross-section comparison of two mattress materials side by side: a foam cushion with visible cell structure and density gradient on the left, a spring coil system with metal springs and padding layers on the right, photographed from directly above on a neutral gray background with soft diffused lighting, shot at 45-degree angle to show depth and texture details, professional product photography style, high contrast between materials

alt: Corte transversal de uma base box mostrando camadas internas de molas e estrutura
prompt: Cross-section view of a box bed base showing internal construction with metal springs, wooden frame and support structure visible, detailed cutaway perspective revealing layers and mechanical components, professional product demonstration photography, neutral background

alt: Estrutura de uma mesa de trabalho mostrando suas características construtivas
prompt: Close-up photograph of a work desk construction detail, showing solid wood frame joints, metal reinforcement brackets underneath the tabletop, sturdy leg supports with cross-bracing, cable management channels routed into the surface, and the thickness of the desktop material. Shoot from a low angle to emphasize the structural engineering and durability features that differentiate it from regular tables. Include visible dovetail joints, mortise connections, and the transition where the legs meet the desktop support system.
